corrections.reason: The glyph has the top-right loop of 7th-order ጆ (ቀንጆ, archaic/dialectal form of ቆንጆ 'proper/true Union'), not 5th-order ጄ.
The cited Ge'ez demonstrative pronoun from line 1 (ወዘንተ/ዝንተ) is printed with 6th-order ዝ (ዝንተ), not 1st-order ዘ.
The Amharic accusative pronoun 'anyone' is printed ማንን (with two 6th-order ን glyphs in ማንንም ፡ ማንን), where the middle ን was misread as ነ.
In the Ge'ez root text (1 John 2:27), the nominative subject before ዚአሁ is printed መንፈስ (with 6th-order ስ) and the verb is printed ይሜህርክሙ (with 6th-order ር).

corrections.corrected_text: እንደ ፡ ገናን ፡ ትሉኝ ፡ እንደ ፡ ሆነ ፡ ከዚ
